description: WitMotion WT901BLECL: Bluetooth 5.0 inclinometer and IMU with a built-in battery
identify_by_touch: A small, flat plastic case with a mounting tab at each end.
notes: Sale price; regular price 47.90. Also sold on Amazon as ASIN B07T2C97WN. WitMotion lists different sizes and battery capacities on different pages, so measure your unit before printing.

description: 3D-printed cube in two halves, upper_cube and lower_cube. Print them from the STL or 3MF files on the GitHub release.
identify_by_touch: Two halves. The taller one has a plain, closed top. The shorter one has an open pocket for the sensor and a small half-round hole at the bottom of one corner.
notes: Design version v0.1.0. PLA, 0.06 mm layers, no supports; the full print settings are in docs/cube.md.
